description: In 1983, a team of deeply religious scientists conducted a radical, forbidden experiment in an undisclosed underground facility. They believed our physical senses cloud our awareness of eternity—and without them, human thought could establish direct contact with God.

An elderly volunteer agreed to have every sensory nerve connection to his brain surgically severed. He could not see, hear, taste, smell, or feel. But instead of touching divine light, his silent void was invaded by hundreds of dead voices that refused to leave him alone.
A Scroll Kaos full 3D horror story. Watch until the very end.
